question: What power and fruit are attributed to the hūṃ seed mantra in this teaching?
premises: hūṃ is identified as the bīja.
It is said to grant the fruit of the four goals.
inference: The hūṃ bīja is the mantra-power that grants the fruits of the four goals.
plain_english: The seed syllable hūṃ should be the mantra-power that grants the fruits of the four aims of life.
